structured_output.summary: The finding is real, and it is a gap in the tests, not a bug: race-ui.ts already has `synced = false;` in reset(), but no test failed if that line was deleted. I left game code alone and added the missing coverage. In src/ui/stages/hud-motion.stage.ts I added a stage, 'second-race'. It uses one race UI the way game.ts does. Race 1 runs the overtake to P2 and then a new lap to 2/3. Then the stage calls ui.reset() on the same UI, and race 2's first sync is already racing at P4 on lap 2/3 (raceTick 600, so the entry slide has ended at GO). The new test, tests/ui/hud-motion-second-race.test.ts, renders that stage in Chromium at 844×390. It checks that Pos reads 4 and Lap reads 2/3, and that the Pos panel, its digit and the Lap panel all compute animation-name none. Red/green: with `synced = false;` removed from reset(), the test fails (ui-hud-bump, ui-hud-roll and ui-hud-stamp all play). With the line restored, it passes. pnpm typecheck is clean, and pnpm test passes all 111 files and 740 tests.
